zh.title: 连接稳定与 Android 工作台升级
items: Relay 连接状态与数据投递状态现已分离，单条数据被拒绝不再触发整条连接反复重连。
上传队列会去重并自动缩小批次定位坏数据，健康数据可以继续同步。
Server 接受完全相同的加密事件重放；只有同一序号对应不同内容时才报告冲突。
Android 工作台采用新的原生抽屉和紧凑项目操作，项目会话分批展开，新任务可一次点击创建并立即显示。
Android 新增端到端解密后的本地通知和签名 APK 自动更新；通知不包含消息正文或项目路径。
改进 Android 的历史恢复、附件、审批和任务状态同步，减少重连后的重复状态与加载误判。

en.title: Stable connections and an upgraded Android workspace
items: Relay transport state is now separate from delivery state, so one rejected item no longer causes repeated full reconnects.
The upload queue deduplicates retries and narrows failed batches automatically, allowing healthy data to continue syncing.
The Server accepts exact encrypted-event replays and reports a conflict only when one sequence number identifies different content.
Android now has a native drawer and compact project actions, reveals project sessions progressively, and creates visible sessions in one tap.
Android adds local notifications after end-to-end decryption and signed APK updates; notifications contain neither message text nor project paths.
History recovery, attachments, approvals, and task-state synchronization are more reliable on Android, reducing duplicate state and misleading loading states after reconnects.
